notes.title: Eggsplosion Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
The store page is now live. We will be working hard to finish the game in time during the next six weeks. 
We plan to include a few more QOL features and can add even more past release. The game will be Free To Play and will support up to 4 players locally or through Remote Play on release.

Before this date we might need some play testers and as such a registration button will show up on the page soon. If you are as eggcited as we are, be sure to check out the store page every now and then to grow your chances of getting to test our game before release!

We will be posting patch notes in the appropriate place within the community hub as well as on our website, which you can check out here. 

Thank you for joining us on this journey!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2469370
